content: Tita matɨari paitɨ mɨtimieme, tita temɨte'u'eni, tita temɨte'uxei tahɨxikɨ, tita 'ahurawa temɨtexeiyakai, tita tamamakɨ temɨte'umayɨa, mɨkɨ tekanixekuxaxatɨwani niuki tukari tiyupitɨwame hepaɨtsita.
Tukari matsiɨkɨtɨ kanayani. Tame tekanixeiya, tekanihekɨatani, meta tekatenixe'utaxatɨani mɨkɨ tukari mɨkaxɨwe hepaɨtsita, mɨkɨ yu'ukiyari kaniteɨtakaitɨni meta tepuxeitsitɨarie tame.

Tita temɨte'uxei, tita temɨte'u'eni, mɨkɨ tekanixekuxaxatɨwani xemeta tanaitɨ temɨtaxewinikɨ. Ketemɨtetaxewi tame, ta'ukiyari hamatɨa tepɨtaxewi nu'aya hamatɨa meta Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu hamatɨa tepɨtaxewi.
'Ipaɨ panuyɨne niuki hetsɨana mɨmieme temi'eni meta temɨxekuxaxatɨwa: Kakaɨyari hekɨariya kanihɨkɨtɨni, yɨriya pumawe hetsiena.
Xɨka yate'utiyuani kename hamatɨana tetaxewi, yɨwipa xɨka te'u'uwani, tepɨte'itawa, yuri yatepɨkatekahu.
Matsitsɨ hekɨaripa xɨka te'u'uwani mɨkɨ hekɨaripa makawe hepaɨ, tanaitɨ tekanitaxewikakuni, mɨkɨ meta, Ketsutsi Kakaɨyari nu'aya xuriyaya naime 'axatemɨteyurie katani'itirieka.
Xɨka yate'utiyuani kename tita 'axamɨti'ane tekatehexeiya, takɨmana tepeutayexɨrɨwa, tita yuri mɨraine tahetsie pumawe.
Mexɨka te'itahekɨata tita 'axatemɨte'uyuri, mɨkɨ kemaine yapɨtikamie, kemɨtiheitserie yapɨtiyuriene, tita 'axatemɨte'uyuri pɨtareuyehɨwirieni, katani'itirieka naime mɨkatiheitserie.
Xɨka yate'utiyuani kename 'axatekateyuriwawe, mɨkɨ ti'itawame tekanayeitɨwani, niukieya tahetsie pumawe.
